description: This file defines the interface 'SavingsAccountReadPlatformService' which declares methods for retrieving savings account data, transactions, and related information within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsAccountReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for reading savings account data and transactions.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of savings account data based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves all savings accounts for a specific client for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveActiveForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves active savings accounts for a client, optionally filtered by deposit account type and currency.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific savings account by ID.

methods.name: retrieveDepositTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Provides a deposit transaction template for a savings account.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions for a savings account.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific savings transaction by savings ID and transaction ID.

methods.name: retrieveForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves savings accounts for a client, optionally considering overdraft.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsIdsPendingInactive
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of savings accounts pending inactivation as of a date.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsIdsPendingDormant
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of savings accounts pending dormancy as of a date.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsIdsPendingEscheat
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of savings accounts pending escheat as of a date.

methods.name: isAccountBelongsToClient
methods.description: Checks if an account belongs to a specific client.

methods.name: retrieveAccountNumberByAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves account number using account ID.

methods.name: getAccountsIdsByStatusPaged
methods.description: Retrieves account IDs by status with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveAllSavingsDataForInterestPosting
methods.description: Retrieves all savings data for interest posting, with pagination and status filtering.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactionData
methods.description: Retrieves all transaction data for given reference numbers.

methods.name: retrieveAccountIdByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves account ID using an external ID.

methods.name: retrievePeriodicAccrualData
methods.description: Retrieves periodic accrual data for a savings account up to a specified date.
